newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber market closed for trading holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber market closed for trading holiday.

text.p: The rubber futures market was closed on Tuesday for a trading holiday, an official of the Singapore Commodity Exchange (SICOM) said.
The exchange had said on Monday it would be open until 12 noon local time (0400 GMT), but the official clarified that a trading holiday had been declared today.
"The market will be open until noon on December 31. It will be closed today," the official said.
The market will be closed on Wednesday for Christmas and will be open on Thursday.
On Monday, the total volume traded for the RSS3, RSS1 and TSR20 rubber futures contract reached only 300 tonnes each.
The April/June RSS3 contract settled at 130.50 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 130.75 cents.
The April/June RSS1 contract settled at 183.75 Singapore cents (US$1.31) a kg from the previous 184.25 cents.
The February TSR20 contract settled at 171.75 Singapore cents (US$1.23) a kg from 172.25 cents.
